**What changed:** Added `bm.js` (CLI with `add`/`list`/`rm`, storing data as `{nextId, bookmarks}` in `bookmarks.json` or `$BM_FILE` so ids are never reused even after deletion) and `bm.test.js` (5 tests covering add/list, tag filtering, empty tags, id non-reuse after `rm`, and removing an unknown id). `npm test` passes.
